category_title: Students who freeze and avoid participation during public academic tasks to prevent peer ridicule
scenario_title: Called to the board for math
minimal_context: The student is called to the board in front of the classroom to solve a math problem.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come up to the board and solve this math problem for the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks to the board but stands quietly, not actively participating or picking up the marker.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to try to do it yourself.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks back at the other students, not seeking help or asking any questions about the math problem.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and write the first step on the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I get to that point and I freeze.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please come up to the board and solve this math problem for the class.

STUDENT: (Walks to the board but stands quietly, not actively participating or picking up the marker.)

TUTOR: You need to try to do it yourself.

STUDENT: (Looks back at the other students, not seeking help or asking any questions about the math problem.)

TUTOR: Go ahead and write the first step on the board.

STUDENT: I get to that point and I freeze.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when she was called to the board, the teacher 'said we have to . . . do it ourselves'
related_quotes: I get to that point and I freeze

behavior_patterns.condition: when students were concerned about peer teasing during classroom activities
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: avoidant responses, such as not actively participating in class activities or seeking help
